M2M_QUATERNIUS.label: Quaternius, via Mesh2Motion
M2M_QUATERNIUS.origin: Quaternius' Universal Animation Library 1 and 2 as Mesh2Motion re-exported them on its human rig (human-base-animations.glb). Library 1's clips run 25% longer than in Quaternius' own files, and a few are trimmed or end back on their feet. Each clip's orig names the Quaternius clip it was made from

M2M_ANIMATED.label: Mesh2Motion, hand-animated
M2M_ANIMATED.origin: Animated in Blender by Mesh2Motion's contributors on its human rig (human-addon-animations.glb; the Blender sources are in Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-assets, rigs/human)

M2M_MOCOPI.label: Mesh2Motion, motion capture
M2M_MOCOPI.origin: Captured by Mesh2Motion with a Sony mocopi suit and retargeted onto its human rig with its own Blender add-on (human-mocap-animations.glb; the raw BVH captures are in Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-assets, motion-capture)

$skip.Sword_Regular_A_Rec: Mesh2Motion's re-export whips the whole body round in its last three frames; Quaternius' own clip, which ends cleanly, is Sword_Regular_A_Rec in the Quaternius set
